name: Enchanted Forest
description: A mystical forest filled with ancient trees, magical creatures, and hidden treasures.

name: Misty Mountains
description: Towering peaks shrouded in mist, home to hardy mountain creatures and valuable ore deposits.

name: Coastal Cliffs
description: Dramatic cliffs overlooking a turbulent sea, with hidden caves and mysterious shipwrecks.

name: Desert Dunes
description: A vast desert with shifting sands, ancient ruins, and dangerous heat. Beware of sandstorms!

name: Frozen Tundra
description: An icy wasteland where only the strongest survive. Rich in rare resources and fierce predators.

name: Volcanic Wastes
description: A hellish landscape of lava flows and ash clouds. Extremely dangerous but rewarding for brave adventurers.

name: Ancient Ruins
description: The remains of a once-great civilization, now overrun with traps and guardians protecting forgotten treasures.

name: Celestial Realm
description: A mystical plane where reality bends and powerful entities dwell. Only for the most experienced adventurers.
